sloka: गन्धर्व नगर प्रख्या माया तस्य च रक्षसः ।न्यास भूता असि वैदेहि न्यस्ता मयि महात्मना ॥३-४५-१७॥
transliteration: gandharva nagara prakhyā māyā tasya ca rakṣasaḥ ।nyāsa bhūtā asi vaidehi nyastā mayi mahātmanā ॥3-45-17॥

translations.english: O best of women Vaidehi great Rama has entrusted your safty to me. I do not wish to leave you here alone.
